IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!!

An all-out grocery-store rampage starring one dangerously hungry cereal mascot.

View on SteamSee the game
01 / The game

Built around a mechanic you can explain in one sentence.

IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!! is a compact arcade action adventure built around speed, grabbing, throwing, and a supermarket that rapidly stops resembling a place of business.

03 / Design

The systems behind the premise.

Developer credit — Metater · Gameplay development · Production and launch

01

Grab everything

Shelves, groceries, props, and enemies become part of a fast physical combat loop.

02

Arcade momentum

Short objectives and escalating encounters keep the game moving instead of pausing for exposition.

03

Readable chaos

Strong silhouettes, bright effects, and a simple input language keep the action legible at full speed.

04

A compact game shaped under Jatater Worldwide from production through launch.
